transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As Corporate Secretary, I need to convene us to address the incident-response situation and determine whether a Form 8-K filing is required before tomorrow's board meeting. Let me start by asking each of you for your recommendations so we can move through the pre-filing process efficiently. First, could our cybersecurity lead assess the incident and let us know what classification it falls under and whether you believe it triggers any SEC disclosure obligation? And from the privacy lead, do we have a sense of the affected-account count? Finally, from investor relations, what is your view on whether market participants would consider this material? I also want to flag that our existing draft communications are fairly general — they don't specify the regulatory classification, affected-account count, detailed operational impact, or how any ransom demand is being handled. Under our board-approved process, the final filing package will need a clear operational-continuity statement, must omit ransom-demand details, and must document board review before I can authorize filing. So let's work through each of those items.
